text:
[issue by NR-5tudio]
Hey!
i wanted to use `fancy menu` mod for `1.24.4 forge`
i installed all the used mods
such as `melody` and `konkrete`. but the game crashed i thought that the mod is the broken one so i removed it (i kept the `melody` and `konkrete`, but i deleted fancy mod for testing) and still crashing so i removed `melody` and still crashing but when i deleted `konkrete` it stops crashing
im not sure what is the issue exactly but i do know that there is an issue, WHO KNOWS maybe im dum :D
Thank you :).

[comment by Keksuccino (owner)]
I can't do anything without the log.
Please send your `/logs/latest.log` AFTER the game crashed, thank you.

[comment by NR-5tudio (none)]
okie :D
here it is!

[latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22785409/latest.log)

if im not wrong i think this is the log you asked for

[comment by Keksuccino (owner)]
Your whole instance looks kinda cursed tbh.
It looks like it fails to read lots of mixin-related stuff, which is bad.

Also you use OptiFine, which is not compatible with my mods. You should use [OptiFine alternatives](https://docs.fancymenu.net/en/optifine-alternatives), which are more stable and don't break tons of mods, like OF does 😅

In short: Konkrete for MC 1.21.4 works fine, so it crashing means there's something wrong on your end. Be it a mod conflict, mod loader shenanigans, your instance being broken or OF being a pile of garbage lmao

I will close this for now, since it's more a support thing. If you need more help, please join my Discord (invite is on all my project pages). Thank you very much!
